changes.now: Whosoever holds this hammer, if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor.
changes.proposed: This drink, I like it. Another!
changes.evidence: In Thor (2011) the hammer line is Odin's: he whispers it to Mjolnir as he banishes Thor to Earth (Wikiquote, Thor (film), Dialogue). Thor never says it, so it fails the character-box test. The proposed line is Thor's own in the same film (MCU wiki Thor/Quote, 'Spoken by Thor'); any other line Thor speaks would do.

changes.now: Forget everything you think you know.
changes.evidence: The line is Karl Mordo's to Stephen Strange at Kamar-Taj in Doctor Strange (2016) ('I once stood in your place... Forget everything you think you know.'). Neither Strange nor Wong says it. The proposed line is Strange's own in the same film (MCU wiki Doctor Strange/Quote).

changes.now: It comes with a price. This life you wanna live.
changes.proposed: This life you wanna live. To really help people. Comes a lot of sacrifices.
changes.evidence: Clint's line to Kate in Hawkeye episode 'Partners, Am I Right?' is 'This life you wanna live. To really help people. I mean, try to help people, anyway. Comes a lot of sacrifices.' 'It comes with a price' is not in it. Medium only because a trailer cut could word it differently.
